fe/apps/web/package.json dependencies declares @starci/auth-oidc, which the front-end stack forbids for the auth concern (knowledge/hfs/fe-stack.yaml); use @starci/auth and delete @starci/auth-oidc. modules/auth is the session issuer's client (one @starci/auth client instance over the app's own back-end auth doors, the access token in its memory; full - the app's IdP client, @starci/auth/client/oidc; the retired @starci/auth-oidc is forbidden); it yields the session and the access token for the Apollo link and never reads data.
